s3.ptxt: Start diagnosis and display the service inspection menu screen.
Select "Diagnosis/Diagnostic Information Collection" on the service inspection menu screen to display the diagnosis/diagnostic information collection screen.
Perform HDD diagnosis.

item.ptxt: It takes some time for the check to complete.

If the vehicle interior is cold or hot, the HDD may not operate normally and "NG" may be displayed. Therefore, perform HDD diagnosis after placing the vehicle in a normal temperature environment and bringing the vehicle interior temperature to -20°C or more and 65°C or less.
If the diagnosis result is "NG" even though the vehicle interior temperature is -20°C or more and 65°C or less, replace the navigation receiver assembly.

s3.ptxt: Start diagnosis and display the service inspection menu screen.
Select "Function Check/Adjustment" on the service inspection menu screen.
Select "Panel/Steering SW Check" on the function check/adjustment screen to display the panel/steering SW check screen.
Operate each switch and check that it is displayed on the screen.

table.title: Panel/Steering SW Check Screen Display Content

item.ptxt: Displays the name of the pressed switch while it is pressed
If multiple switches are pressed, "Multiple Switches" is displayed

entry.ptxt: Displays the name of the operated rotary switch (screen display is cleared after 1 seconds of no operation)
Displays the state of the operated rotary switch (screen display is cleared after 1 seconds of no operation)
Returns to the function check/adjustment screen

item.ptxt: If the check result for the switches on the navigation receiver assembly is abnormal, the navigation receiver assembly can be judged to be faulty.

If the inspection result for the switches on the steering pad switch assembly is abnormal, it is necessary to check the steering pad switch assembly (3-spoke steering wheel) (see ), steering pad switch assembly (4-spoke steering wheel) (see ), spiral cable sub-assembly (see ), and wire harness and connector (navigation receiver assembly - steering pad switch assembly) (see ).

s3.ptxt: Start diagnosis and display the service inspection menu screen.
Select "Function Check/Adjustment" on the service inspection menu screen.
Select "Touch SW Check" on the function check/adjustment screen to display the display pressure-sensitive touch switch check screen.
Touch the screen and check that a cross-shaped cursor is displayed at the touched location.

specitem.ptxt: Cursor is displayed at the touched location

item.ptxt: Once a location is judged as touched, the cursor remains displayed until another location is touched.
If the touch SW check result is abnormal, the navigation receiver assembly can be judged to be faulty.

s3.ptxt: Start diagnosis and display the service inspection menu screen.
Select "Function Check/Adjustment" on the service inspection menu screen.
Select "Color Bar Display Check" on the function check/adjustment screen to display the color bar display check screen.
Check that the set colors match the displayed colors.

item.ptxt: When black, red, green, blue, white or horizontal stripes is selected, the selected color or stripes are displayed over the entire screen.
Touch the screen to return.
If the picture quality has been adjusted, the display is shown at the set brightness.
If the color bar display check result is abnormal, the navigation receiver assembly can be judged to be faulty.

Displays inclination angle sensor output status (amount of change in vehicle inclination angle [degrees] since this screen was displayed)

s-1.ptxt: Check Navigation Voice Guidance Settings (When Voice Guidance is not Heard)

s3.ptxt: In the voice settings on the setup/edit screen (navigation), set the volume to maximum and check the voice output.

specitem.ptxt: "Guidance will be given at this volume" is announced

list1.title: In the following cases, voice guidance is not given even if the system is normal.

item.ptxt: When a destination has not been set. (Voice such as prefecture border guidance is output)
When not driving on the route (no remaining distance display at the lower left of the current position screen). (Voice such as prefecture border guidance is output)
When "Guidance in Other Modes" is not set. (Voice guidance is not given on screens other than the map screen)

s-1.ptxt: Check Gyro Initialization (When Vehicle Position Mark Rotates)

s3.ptxt: Turn the IG OFF → ON and check whether it returns to normal.

item.ptxt: If ACC or IG is turned ON while the vehicle is rotating (such as on a turntable), the navigation receiver assembly memorizes the angular velocity at that time as the reference, so the vehicle position rotates even if the system is normal.
In the above case, turning the IG OFF → ACC ON with the vehicle stopped returns it to normal.
